comment: Plans and what they unlock, read by the app (src/lib/entitlements.js) and by the account API (server/entitlements.php). Prices shown come from Stripe; 'amount' (cents, gross) is only what stripe-setup.php creates. Price IDs are in config.php (stripe.prices) or in STRIPE_PRICE_<KEY>.

early_bird.comment: A promotion code at checkout, made by stripe-setup.php: percent off the first payment of a plan of at least minimum_amount (cents, so the yearly plan and the lifetime licence), for the first max_redemptions buyers, until the end of the day 'ends' (Europe/Berlin). Shown on the pricing page while active and not over.
